old_text: Customers shall be able to begin a retail banking application from a web browser or mobile device.
new_text: Customers shall be able to begin a retail banking application from a web browser or mobile device.

old_text: The platform shall send a verification email within 24 hours of application submission.
new_text: The platform shall send a verification email within 10 minutes of application submission.

old_text: Every applicant shall upload a government-issued identity document before account activation.
new_text: Every applicant shall upload a government-issued identity document, and applicants flagged for enhanced identity verification shall also complete a live selfie check before account activation.

old_text: The system shall capture applicant consent to the privacy notice before accepting an application.
new_text: The system shall capture applicant consent to the versioned privacy notice and record the policy version before accepting an application.

old_text: Applications with a configurable risk score of 80 or higher shall be routed to the manual risk-review queue.
new_text: Applications with a configurable risk score of 65 or higher shall be routed to the manual risk-review queue.

old_text: The onboarding session shall time out after 15 minutes of inactivity.
new_text: The onboarding session shall time out after 15 minutes of inactivity.

old_text: The platform shall retain onboarding audit events for 90 days.
new_text: The platform shall retain onboarding audit events for 365 days.

old_text: The customer identity API shall retry a transient connection failure up to two times before creating a support event.
new_text: The customer identity API shall retry a transient connection failure up to two times before creating a support event.

old_text: Every application shall require manual address verification by the operations team.
The customer shall receive a decision notification within two business days after final review.
new_text: The customer shall receive a decision notification within two business days after final review.
Applications with an address mismatch shall be routed to targeted address verification, while matched addresses shall proceed without manual address review.
Applicants unable to complete a live selfie check shall be offered an accessible alternate verification path for agent review.
